Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

hvtiRdatabuild 0.2.0

Breaking Changes

  • Package renamed from hvtiRdatasets to hvtiRdatabuild. The package exports six functions and no data object, so a ...datasets name promised a payload and delivered a pipeline. Update library() calls and any hvtiRdatasets:: prefixes. The repository moved to github.com/ehrlinger/hvtiRdatabuild; GitHub redirects the old URL, so an existing remotes::install_github("ehrlinger/hvtiRdatasets") keeps resolving.
  • The print option hvtiRdatasets.show_ids is now hvtiRdatabuild.show_ids. There is no fallback to the old name: a stale options(hvtiRdatasets.show_ids = TRUE) is ignored and identifiers are not printed. That is the conservative direction for a flag whose own documentation warns it may emit PHI.

No function changed behaviour, so results are identical to 0.1.2.
